name: Carcassonne

categories.label: Roads
categories.help: Points from completed and unfinished roads, one per tile.

categories.label: Cities
categories.help: Points from cities: tiles and pennants, with the finished or unfinished rate.

categories.label: Monasteries
categories.help: Points from monasteries: the tile plus its neighbours.

categories.label: Farms
categories.help: Points from fields: 3 per completed city they touch.

notes: Enter running totals from the board track plus end-of-game scoring. The game ends when the tiles run out. Ties are shared. Player count 2-5 comes from the box.
